title: Closed-Loop AI Slashes Fast-Charging Battery Discovery From 500+ Days to 16 Days
aiSystem: Closed-Loop Bayesian Optimization + Early-Cycle ML Predictor
whyItMatters: Cut the experimental search for 10-minute lithium-ion fast-charging protocols from over 500 days to just 16 days (~30× speedup), discovering counterintuitive high-current protocols that extended battery cycle life.
summary: Peter Attia, Aditya Grover, Norman Jin, Stefano Ermon, Richard Braatz, William Chueh, and collaborators (Stanford University, MIT, and Toyota Research Institute) demonstrated in Nature (2020) a landmark closed-loop machine-learning system for energy-storage optimization. Combining an early-cycle ML model that predicts full battery lifetime from just the first 100 charge–discharge cycles with Bayesian optimization over 224 candidate 10-minute fast-charging protocols, the closed-loop system autonomously selected experiments and discovered optimal non-intuitive charging profiles in 16 days instead of >500 days of exhaustive cycling—dramatically outperforming industry heuristics.
technicalHighlights: Combined early-cycle ML lifetime prediction (from the first 100 cycles) with Bayesian optimization to explore a 224-protocol six-step fast-charging parameter space.
Reduced total experimental validation time from >500 days (exhaustive search) to 16 days—a >30× physical laboratory acceleration.
Autonomously discovered counterintuitive charging protocols that minimized lithium plating and thermal degradation, verified across independent cell batches.
caveats: Validated on commercial lithium-iron-phosphate (LFP/graphite) cylindrical cells; transferring optimal protocols across NMC chemistries or varying ambient temperatures requires fresh calibration.

scoreRationale.foundational: Canonical blueprint for coupling predictive ML surrogates with Bayesian optimization to accelerate slow physical experiments.
scoreRationale.ripple: Widely adopted across EV battery R&D, electrolyte formulation, and closed-loop materials engineering.
scoreRationale.verification: Published in Nature with rigorous physical cycling validation across independent commercial cell batches.
scoreRationale.velocity: Delivered a >30× real-world wet-lab speedup (500+ days down to 16 days) in battery protocol discovery.

sources.label: Nature (2020): Closed-loop optimization of fast-charging protocols for batteries with machine learning
